title: Rusty Putter
body:
"It may be missing a few bolts and be slightly unsafe for driving, but it'll get you to where you need to go (slowly)." -The ingame description.

Description

The Rusty Putter is a vehicle that can be bought at The Lighthouse for $50.

It used to be the beginner vehicle when starting the game until it was replaced by the Rusty Joop Barrow.

Trivia

  • This is the cheapest vehicle that can be bought ingame.
  • It is also the slowest, bumpiest (unstable) vehicle in the game and has the least usable storage.
  • This vehicle can be often buggy.
  • Unless you lose your starter vehicle, there is absolutely no reason to use this vehicle for everyday use unless you want to suffer.
